title: Claims Desk Guide: Out-of-Network Service Reimbursement, Cardinal Roadside Assistance
content:
## Rule

A Cardinal Roadside Assistance member who could not reach Cardinal dispatch and paid a provider outside the Cardinal network for a covered service is reimbursed against an itemized receipt, up to the option's out-of-network reimbursement cap per service call. The reimbursement uses a call from the allowance. Receipts are reimbursed only when submitted no later than 60 calendar days after the service date. Days count from the service date on the receipt, that date being day 0, and a receipt received on the last day is in time. Reimbursement is paid within 10 calendar days of complete receipts. A receipt is reimbursed once.

## Reimbursement schedule

| Option | Most reimbursed per service call | Itemized receipt needed | Submit receipts within | Paid within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | $75.00 | Yes | 60 calendar days of the service date | 10 calendar days of complete receipts |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | $100.00 | Yes | 60 calendar days of the service date | 10 calendar days of complete receipts |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | $125.00 | Yes | 60 calendar days of the service date | 10 calendar days of complete receipts |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | $150.00 | Yes | 60 calendar days of the service date | 10 calendar days of complete receipts |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | $200.00 | Yes | 60 calendar days of the service date | 10 calendar days of complete receipts |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | $250.00 | Yes | 60 calendar days of the service date | 10 calendar days of complete receipts |

## Amount reimbursed

The amount reimbursed for one service call is the lower of the amount the member paid the out-of-network provider and the option's cap.

| Option (cap) | Hypothetical amount paid by the member | Reimbursed |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Standard ($100.00) | $85.00 | $85.00 |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard ($100.00) | $140.00 | $100.00 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier ($200.00) | $200.00 | $200.00 |

Each such reimbursement also uses one call from the vehicle's allowance.

## Time limit for receipts

- **Clock starts:** the service date printed on the receipt, counted as day 0.
- **Counting:** calendar days.
- **Limit:** received no later than day 60.
- **On the boundary:** a receipt received on day 60 is in time.
- **Evidence:** the service date and the receipt number exactly as printed on the receipt, as held on the company's records for that receipt.

Boundary cases on a hypothetical service date of 1 June:

| Receipt received | Day count | In time? |
|---|---|---|
| 30 July | Day 59 | Yes |
| 31 July | Day 60 | Yes, the last day is in time |
| 1 August | Day 61 | No |

## Basis Q&A

**Is a receipt that has already been reimbursed paid again?** No. A receipt is reimbursed once; receipts are identified by the receipt number exactly as printed.

**What document supports the claim?** An itemized receipt from the provider, on every option.

**When is the money paid?** Within 10 calendar days of the receipts being complete.
